command: from pathlib import Path; import sys,json,hashlib; paths=[p for d in ("src/facemath","scripts","tests") for p in Path(d).rglob("*.py")]; records=[(str(p),hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()) for p in paths if compile(p.read_bytes(),str(p),"exec")]; print(json.dumps({"python":sys.version,"parsed":len(records),"files":records},indent=2))
